name: Gisellma Firmansyah
bio:
Gisellma Saula Sajidah Firmansyah (born December 11, 2005) is an Indonesian actress.

In 2017, Gisellma began her journey into the acting world by shooting for the film Foxtrot Six, which was released in 2019. She gained widespread public recognition after her role as Della Atmodjo in the film Sewu Dino (2023).
